label: B25-GOLDEN-ONLY-VOLATILE-RECOVERY
title: Restore and prove the exact golden SOF without rerunning candidate or terminal
dependency_exception: T-037 fully passed candidate functionality but its sole golden programmer attempt failed; this successor is restricted to golden-only recovery and must not rerun candidate or terminal.

authorization.source: Existing user authorization for Quartus/JTAG volatile configuration and test plus the T-037 failure policy requiring golden restoration.
authorization.scope: Exactly one volatile programming attempt of the frozen golden SOF and read-only final enumeration.

scope: Copy the exact T-036 sealed bundle unchanged, create a task-specific manifest, fresh-bootstrap and revalidate AST/seal, invoke the sealed program_once.ps1 exactly once in golden mode, then directly enumerate the standard JTAG chain. No candidate or terminal path is present.

acceptance.immutability: All nine tool hashes equal T-036; only a T-038 manifest and task-specific Bash recovery wrapper are new. No reusable tool edits.
acceptance.freshness: T-038 root/bootstrap absent; one bootstrap/upload; remote AST 6/6 and seal 9/9 PASS before recovery.
acceptance.preconditions: program_once.ps1 itself requires exact candidate/golden file identities, no conflicting EDA/programmer/terminal, port1310 free and one preserved standard jtagserver. The cached pre-recovery design hash is not used as a gate.
acceptance.single_use: Invoke program_once.ps1 exactly once with Mode=golden and one run label. Durable golden marker count=1; candidate marker absent; candidate programmer/terminal counts=0; no retry.
acceptance.programmer: Require exact golden path/checksum/JTAG-ID, exit0, configuration and operation success, Quartus programmer 0 errors/0 warnings, owned server stopped, standard server preserved, post-busy=0 and port1310 free.
acceptance.final_chain: After successful programmer only, invoke jtagconfig.exe -n once through the preserved standard server. Require cable/JTAG-ID, golden design hash and JTAG UART/PHY nodes. Combined successful golden transaction plus final chain proves live golden.
acceptance.artifact: Fetch marker, program result/stdout/stderr/server manifest and final enumeration; hash-bind every artifact and final resource status.
acceptance.boundary: Candidate SOF, nios2-terminal, input bytes, reset/power/Flash and process termination remain zero.

failure_policy: One recovery attempt only. Any setup/AST/seal/precondition/programmer/enumeration failure ends the task with live state unproven; no replacement script, root recreation, retry, candidate/terminal, reset/power or Flash action.
resource: One uninterrupted resource-lock gamepc window for setup, single golden programming, fetch and final enumeration.
forbidden_regions: more than one golden marker/programmer call or any retry
JIC/EPCQ/Flash, reset, power cycle, standard/unknown process stop
claiming final golden from cached enumeration without a successful golden programmer transaction

dispatch.monitoring: event-driven; one-hour maximum wait; no frequent polling

result.acceptance: PASS; one exact golden volatile programming transaction plus one final standard-server chain enumeration proves the live FPGA is the frozen golden design.
result.golden_program: PASS; Quartus programmer PID 18828 exited 0 with configuration, operation, checksum and JTAG-ID acceptance and 0 errors/0 warnings.
result.final_chain: PASS; exact cable/JTAG ID/golden design hash plus JTAG UART #0 and JTAG PHY #0.
result.safety: candidate programmer=0, terminal=0, JIC/EPCQ/Flash=0, reset/power=0, standard/unknown process stop=0; only task-owned server PID 56352 stopped.
result.next: No further GamePC access or hardware rerun is required for this closeout.
